# Repository instructions

This repository supports local browser UI testing. Follow `AGENTS.md` and load
`.github/skills/ui-test/SKILL.md` for project conventions and the official
`.github/skills/playwright-cli/SKILL.md` for browser operations. Do not add custom
workspace, report generation, or browser wrapper scripts. Read only the selected project's
instructions and plan. Return a local Markdown report and evidence directory;
Jira and Confluence are handled separately. Never report an unexecuted check as passed.
